visual_depth_correction_acceptance.reference_frame: #100 declared frame; synthetic footage has no independent physical scale

validation_plan.gate_aggregation: report each fold and leave-one-band-out result; every held-out floor and ceiling q90 must meet its 5 cm limit

smooth_scale_field.term_count_justification: A quadratic in elevation angle and log-depth is the smallest field here that permits smooth curvature and one cross-term; it is fixed before validation to limit overfit, especially for the sparse floor band.

plane_snapping.wall_correction: same smooth scale field or one global ray-derived scale

plane_fit_follow_up.method: Fit z=a*x+b*y+c independently to the run-05 background depth-sheet points in panorama floor and ceiling bands, within the registered source camera's horizontal field of view. Solve the uniform scale so the two fitted planes differ by the #100 declared 2.4 m clear height at the #100 landmark x/z. The #100 height is a synthetic-scene convention, not a surveyed dimension.
plane_fit_follow_up.panorama_pixel_correspondence_check: 1000 sampled PLY vertex colors exactly match the bicubic-resized remove_fg1_image_sr.png at row/column positions; exact_fraction=1.0, max_channel_error=0
plane_fit_follow_up.point_selection_convention: v is panorama row fraction from top (horizon v=0.5); yaw is measured from local -X forward toward local +Y; include points with absolute yaw <= 35 degrees and v in the inclusive bands below

plane_aligned_diagnostic_transform.note: Aligns the two fitted planes to the #100 declared floor/ceiling at the reference x/z, but shifts the registered camera anchor down by 12.0 cm. Recorded as a diagnostic alternative, not the adopted transform.

limitations: Scale is derived from the #100 synthetic 2.4 m convention, not physical measurement.
Floor and ceiling are fitted depth-sheet surfaces, not confirmed point correspondences or collidable planes.
Camera-anchored planes are about 12 cm above the #100 reference at the selected x/z; choosing vertical plane alignment instead violates the camera-center anchor by the same amount.
Zero matched Hunyuan-to-#100 point landmarks, so mesh reprojection residual is unavailable.
One source frame and one panorama zone only; cross-zone overlap is unavailable.

prior_frame_141_render.result: forward composition and vertex-color mesh render verified in #133

validation.cross_zone_overlap: not_tested; only same-panorama mesh variants exist

source_camera_target_projection_check.note: Existing camera-contract check only; this target is not a matched Hunyuan mesh landmark.

alignment_scale_reference.reason: Synthetic footage has no physical reference; this is an explicit convention, not a measurement.

missing_calibration_inputs: A surveyed real-world dimension visible in the Hunyuan mesh, or confirmed matched Hunyuan mesh landmarks and #100 3D landmarks. Current 1.558285848 scale only adopts #100's synthetic 2.4 m floor-to-ceiling convention for a candidate mapping; the #100 5.128383849 m/Nerfstudio-unit factor itself is not transferable to Hunyuan coordinates.

Confirmed Hunyuan-to-#100 point correspondences or equivalent image evidence that resolves the 12 cm conflict between preserving the registered camera-center anchor and aligning the fitted floor/ceiling planes. Current plane labels are semantic fits, not matched point landmarks.
A route-wide floor reference with measured or independently confirmed vertical alignment for geometric floor evaluation; the fitted surface tilt and residuals are not collision approval.
At least one independently generated Hunyuan zone from a different registered source frame for cross-zone overlap evaluation.

assessment_history.reason: No Hunyuan mesh plane measurement had yet been compared to the #100 declared floor/ceiling convention.

Run-05 background depth sheet contains locally planar floor and ceiling patches; matching their separation to the #100 chosen 2.4 m convention yields a candidate scale. The 12 cm camera-anchor versus vertical-plane-alignment discrepancy prevents registration acceptance.

prohibited_interpretation: Do not treat the candidate scale as surveyed metric geometry, use it for collision, or infer walkability. The prior null value described the initial assessment before the CPU plane-fit follow-up; scale_calibrated remains false.
